terms.title: Terms of use
terms.pending: Draft to be validated by a lawyer before launch: it describes how the platform works and does not bind MoroccoTravelRide yet.

role.title: Role of the platform
role.body: MoroccoTravelRide connects travelers with licensed and verified tourist transport companies. The trip is carried out by the chosen company, which sets its prices and collects the payment.

booking.title: Booking
booking.body: Bookings are made at least 24 hours before pickup. The carrier confirms within 2 hours; otherwise the booking is cancelled at no cost.

payment.title: Payment
payment.body: The displayed price is all-inclusive. It is paid to the carrier, by bank transfer before the trip or in cash to the driver. No card is requested online.

cancellation.title: Cancellation
cancellation.body: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before pickup, 50 % refund between 48 and 24 hours, no refund within 24 hours. If nothing was paid, cancelling is free.

carriers.title: Carriers
carriers.body: Carriers have a management workspace, a subscription for the management tools, and pay the platform a commission on trips booked through the marketplace.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.pending: Draft to be validated by a lawyer and declared to the CNDP (law 09-08) before launch.

data.title: Data collected
data.body: Travelers: name, e-mail, phone, addresses and trip date, needed for the booking. Carriers: legal company details, license documents, member accounts. Drivers: location during trips in progress only.

purposes.title: Purposes
purposes.body: Carry out and follow transfers, invoice, secure the platform (abuse prevention, audit trail) and meet accounting obligations.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Driver locations: 90 days. E-mail sending queue: 90 days. Invoices and accounting data: legal period (to be specified). Final periods are to be validated.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.body: The carrier performing the trip, the platform, and its technical providers (hosting, e-mail sending, anti-bot protection, error monitoring without personal data).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Access, correction, objection and deletion: write to the platform's contact address. Details will be given after the CNDP declaration.

notice.title: Legal notice
notice.pending: Publisher details to be completed (company name, head office, RC, ICE, publication director, host) before launch.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.body: Virtual private server rented from Contabo (Europe). The host's full details will be given here.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Platform e-mail address and phone, as set by the administrator.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.pending: Draft to be validated by a lawyer before launch.

essential.title: Essential cookies
essential.body: Session of carrier and administrator accounts, secure access to a guest booking, chosen language. They are required for the service and are not used for advertising.

security.title: Security
security.body: The anti-bot check (Cloudflare Turnstile) may set its own technical items when signing in, signing up and booking.

none.title: No advertising tracking
none.body: The platform uses no advertising cookie and no third-party analytics tool at this time.
